title: Rule BL-27 as OD-23: transcript coverage is reported, and zero coverage refuses
body:
Rules **BL-27** as **OD-23**, adding **R1012**.

`select` and `estimate` read the transcript cache. Neither says how much of it
they actually read, so a run that read nothing produces the same console output
as a finished one — measured on 2026-08-24, closing with R7's "The pipeline
STOPS here" over a zero-token projection.

**R1012:** every stage that reads the cache reports its coverage of the
population it is working on, on every run, whether or not anything is wrong.
Zero coverage over a non-empty selection refuses, names `fetch`, and exits
non-zero. A partial cache stays tolerated exactly as today — the per-video rule
R24's failure ledger owns is correct and is not what failed. The projection
carries the same figure beside its character count.

**R1005 (OD-9) was weighed and does not reach it.** No artifact was missing;
both `data/index.jsonl` and `data/selected.jsonl` existed and parsed. Reading
"missing artifact" to mean "an artifact implying an upstream stage never ran"
would make one requirement enforce a rule it does not state — the over-claim
OD-20 names.

Ledger entry only. The plan follows on its own pull request, then the code.
